notes.title: Beta-1.0.1 UPDATE
notes.content:
[p]Hi, Eddy again![/p][p]Thank you to everyone who shared suggestions and reported bugs. Your voices have been heard, and we have worked on fixing a lot of bugs this week.[/p][p] [b]Changes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Base stat line for Rook is nerfed to 2/3.
[/p][/*][*][p]Base stat line for Bishop is nerfed to 3/2.
[/p][/*][*][p]CheapSkate is nerfed to 2/4.
[/p][/*][*][p]Cookie is changed to: “Heal a friendly non-king piece to full.”
[/p][/*][*][p]Gearup is changed to: “Pay X to give a friendly piece +X+1 Attack this turn.”
[/p][/*][*][p]Gobleader is changed to: “Every 3 turns, steal a card from the opponent's hand.”
[/p][/*][*][p]Vengeful Spirit buffed to 3/1.
[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the number of shop encounters.
[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Overture from Raise Flag.
[/p][/*][*][p]Removed Overture from Best Offer.
[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the hand size to 7.
[/p][/*][*][p]Made tutorials more understandable.
[/p][/*][*][p]Added a rook to the Syndicate starting deck.
[/p][/*][*][p]Added a move to the Syndicate starting deck.
[/p][/*][*][p]Gave sacrificed pieces a different outline color.
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed the bug where alt-tabbing sometimes froze the game.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where pressing "Esc" twice froze the game.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug report system.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where the same piece could be sacrificed twice.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual bugs where keywords were not displayed correctly.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where the graveyard’s remaining card text lingered after shuffling.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where deck inspection showed up when using the rightmost card.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some known memory leaks.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where Thorn did not trigger correctly.
[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some wording in English and Simplified Chinese.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the bug where cancel usage of TradeOff will still trigger the effect. [/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: BETA - 1.0 IS HERE !!!
notes.content: [p]HI everyone![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45550839/69b2bcd4a7b7032d1f6e54e6c26f77136772d356.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Eddy here! When you see this post, [b]Beta-1.0[/b] of [b]Gambetto[/b] has been released. You can find the download page below this post.[/p][p]Developing this game has been an incredible journey, and I can't wait to share more about my past and future stories with you.[/p][p]If you have any questions, feel free to post them here, on our Discord server, or through the in-game bug/feedback report system.[/p][p]Hope you enjoy it![/p]
